methods.label: Use the percentage relationship
methods.explanation: 20 is \(25\%\) of 80. The calculation here gives 25.
methods.levelReason: Interpreting a percentage relationship is within Grade 6 scope.

methods.label: Compute the decimal quotient, then multiply by 100
methods.explanation:
Multiplication and division have equal priority, so evaluate from left to right. First \(20\div80=0.25\). Multiplying by \(100\) moves the decimal point two places to the right, so
\[
20\div80\times100=0.25\times100=25.
\]
methods.levelReason: This direct arithmetic route uses Grade 5 decimal division and Grade 4 decimal scaling; p112 supports only the operation-order interpretation.
